predict.question: You back a small venture, case B: a 5% chance it nets 19 credits, otherwise you lose 1. On average, what does case B net?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Zero to One emphasizes that a few exceptional outcomes can dominate venture returns.
modelBoundary: A averages {A}; B {B}. Both lose one credit in 95% of cases; the 5% return branch changes enough to move the whole average. Both distributions are invented; no venture return law or investment recommendation is established.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
